origin.basis: Hutchinson was founded in 1853 in Châlette-sur-Loing, France, and has made bicycle tires since 1890 (company history).

manufacturing.basis: Hutchinson's reference table marks every listed size as Made in France.

availability.note: Hutchinson lists dealers rather than an online price; regional retail availability was not checked in this pass.

wet_notes.summary: Hutchinson claims exceptional wet-weather grip from the Safetread shoulder compound; no independent wet test found.

name: Blackbird Allseason TLR
positioning: Hutchinson's all-weather training tire with a Safetread shoulder compound and Gridskin sidewalls, tubeless-ready.
hookless_note: Hutchinson lists the tubeless-ready sizes from 28 mm as compatible with hooked and hookless rims within its maximum pressures.
caveats: No official price; Hutchinson sells through dealers.
Wet grip is a maker claim; no independent wet test found.

image.shown: Blackbird Allseason as pictured on Hutchinson's product page; Hutchinson shows this photo for the tubeless and tube-type versions, and the construction is not visible.
image.alt: Hutchinson Blackbird Allseason road tire with siped tread on a carbon rim
